## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与结果

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user.

## Validation / 验证

List commands actually run and their results. State what remains untested.

## Compatibility and cleanup / 兼容与清理

Does this change profile format, persistent policies, credentials or uninstall steps?

- [ ] No credentials, private IPs, personal paths or user logs are included.
